description: This Java source file defines the class ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper, which provides methods to retrieve cluster status and health information, including roles and health status, from a distributed cluster environment using Akka actors and JSON processing.

classes.name: ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper
classes.description: Helper class for retrieving cluster status and health information, including roles and health status, via Akka actors and JSON processing.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper with specified ActorSystem, cluster state supplier, and health check configuration.

methods.name: retrieveOverallRolesStatus
methods.description: Retrieves static status information from each reachable cluster member, grouped by role, returning a JSON object with roles as keys.

methods.name: retrieveOverallRolesHealth
methods.description: Retrieves health information from each reachable cluster member, grouped by role, returning a StatusInfo object.

methods.name: sendCommandToRemoteAddresses
methods.description: Sends a command to a collection of remote actor addresses and processes responses using a response transformer.
